uiLocale.description: BCP 47 code of THIS translation (e.g. "de", "ar"). Used for dates, times and the page language, so they match the text instead of the browser's language. Translators: replace with your locale code.

extName.description: Extension name, shown in the browser and in stores.

extDescription.message: Sync tabs, history, bookmarks and extensions across Chrome, Edge and Firefox. End-to-end encrypted, self-hostable.
extDescription.description: Extension description, shown in the browser and in stores. At most 132 characters (Chrome Web Store).

popupNotConnected.message: This browser isn't connected to a Tazamun account yet.
popupNotConnected.description: Popup text before the user has set up an account.

popupSetUp.description: Popup button that opens the onboarding page.

popupLocked.message: Tazamun is locked. Enter your passphrase to unlock it.
popupLocked.description: Popup status when the account key isn't remembered and the browser was restarted.

popupUnlock.description: Popup button that opens the settings page to unlock.

popupOpenSettings.description: Popup button that opens the options page.

optionsAccount.description: Heading of the account section on the options page.

optionsRememberKey.message: Remember the key on this device
optionsRememberKey.description: Checkbox: keep the account key after the browser closes.

optionsRememberKeyHelp.message: When off, Tazamun asks for your passphrase each time the browser starts. Safer on a shared computer, but less convenient.

optionsSignOut.description: Button: sign this device out. Local data stays.

optionsSignOutHelp.message: Signing out stops syncing on this browser. Your data on this browser and on the server stays.
optionsSignOutHelp.description: Explanation next to the sign-out button.

optionsSignedOut.message: You signed out on this browser. Your local data is still here.
optionsSignedOut.description: Options page text after the user signed out.

optionsRevoked.message: This browser was signed out from another device: it was removed from your account, or the passphrase was changed. It stopped syncing; your local data is still here.
optionsRevoked.description: Options page text after the device was revoked elsewhere.

optionsSignInAgain.description: Button: reconnect this browser to the account.

optionsForget.message: Remove the account from this browser
optionsForget.description: Button: forget server URL, account ID and device ID on this browser.

optionsForgetConfirm.message: Remove the account from this browser? Your data on the server stays, and you can sign in again with your username and passphrase.
optionsForgetConfirm.description: Confirmation before forgetting the account on this browser.

optionsNotConnected.message: This browser isn't connected to a Tazamun account.

optionsUnlockLead.message: Tazamun is locked because the key isn't remembered on this device. Enter your passphrase to unlock.

unlockButton.description: Button that unlocks with the passphrase.

unlockWrongPassphrase.message: That passphrase doesn't open this account.
unlockWrongPassphrase.description: Error after unlocking with a wrong passphrase.

deviceDefaultName.description: Default device name, e.g. “Firefox on Windows”.

onboardingTitle.description: Title of the page that opens after installing.

onboardingLead.message: Tazamun keeps your tabs, history, bookmarks and extension list in sync across Chrome, Edge and Firefox. Everything is encrypted on your devices before it leaves them; the server only ever sees ciphertext.
onboardingLead.description: First paragraph on the welcome page.

onboardingCreate.description: Button: start creating a new account.

onboardingConnect.message: Sign in to an existing account
onboardingConnect.description: Button: connect this browser to an account made elsewhere.

onboardingConnectHelp.message: You already use Tazamun in another browser.

onboardingReconnect.description: Button on the welcome page when this browser was connected before.

serverLead.message: Tazamun stores your encrypted data on a server you choose, usually one you or someone you trust runs. Enter its address.

serverUrlLabel.description: Label of the server URL field.

serverPermissionNote.message: Your browser will ask to let Tazamun talk to this server. Tazamun contacts no other site.
serverPermissionNote.description: Note before the host permission prompt.

deviceNameLabel.description: Label of the device name field.

deviceNameHelp.message: Shown on your other devices, for example when sending a tab. Add the profile if you use several. The server can see this name.
deviceNameHelp.description: Hint under the device name field.

moduleTabsHelp.message: See and open other browsers' tabs, and send tabs between them. Private windows are never included.

modulesLater.message: History, bookmarks and the extension list follow in later versions.
modulesLater.description: Note about modules not available yet.

passphraseHeading.description: Heading of the passphrase step when creating.

passphraseLead.message: Your passphrase encrypts everything. It never leaves this browser, and the server’s operator can’t reset it. After this step you get a recovery key, the only other way in.

passphraseConfirmLabel.description: Label of the passphrase confirmation field.

passphraseHint.message: At least 12 characters. Several random words are strong and easy to type.

passphraseAcknowledge.message: I understand that if I lose both my passphrase and my recovery key, my synced data is lost. Nobody can reset them.
passphraseAcknowledge.description: Checkbox the user must tick before creating the account (ACC-4).

inviteHelp.message: This server needs an invite. Ask its operator for one.

signInHeading.description: Heading of the passphrase step when connecting.

signInButton.description: Button that signs in to an existing account.

deriving.message: Securing your keys… this takes a few seconds.

doneHeading.description: Heading of the last onboarding step.

doneLead.message: Tazamun’s toolbar button shows its status. To add another browser, install Tazamun there and sign in with your server address, username and passphrase.
doneLead.description: Text of the last onboarding step.

doneClose.description: Button that closes the onboarding tab.

errorServerUrlInvalid.message: That isn't a valid server address.
errorServerUrlInvalid.description: Error: server URL can't be parsed.

errorServerUrlInsecure.message: The server must use HTTPS. Plain HTTP works only for localhost.
errorServerUrlInsecure.description: Error: http URL that isn't localhost.

errorServerUrlExtra.message: Enter the server address only, without a user name, query or #.
errorServerUrlExtra.description: Error: URL with credentials, query or fragment.

errorPermissionDenied.message: Tazamun needs permission to talk to the server. Try again and choose Allow.

errorUnreachable.message: The server couldn't be reached. Check the address and your connection.

errorNotTazamun.message: That address answers, but it isn't a Tazamun server, or it runs an incompatible version.

errorClientTooOld.message: This server needs a newer version of the extension. Update Tazamun and try again.

errorRegistrationClosed.message: This server doesn't accept new accounts.

errorInviteRequired.message: This server needs an invite code.

errorInviteInvalid.message: That invite code isn't valid, has expired, or was already used.

errorPassphraseTooShort.message: The passphrase needs at least 12 characters.

errorAcknowledge.message: Please confirm that you understand a lost passphrase and recovery key can’t be replaced.

errorInvalidCredentials.message: The username or passphrase is wrong.
errorInvalidCredentials.description: Error: sign-in refused (deliberately doesn't say which).

errorRateLimited.message: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

errorUnsafeServer.message: The server sent key data that this extension refuses for your safety. Contact the server's operator.
errorUnsafeServer.description: Error: KDF parameters below the floor or a key bundle that doesn't open.

errorGeneric.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

statusIdle.description: Status line after a successful sync.

statusIdleNever.message: Connected. Waiting for the first sync.
statusIdleNever.description: Status line before the first sync completed.

statusPaused.message: Sync is paused on this browser.

statusOffline.message: Can't reach the server. Changes are kept and sent when it's back.
statusOffline.description: Status line when the server is unreachable.

statusError.message: Sync ran into a problem and will retry automatically.
statusError.description: Status line for a server error.

statusQuota.message: Your account is full on this server. Ask its operator for more space.

statusRateLimited.message: The server asked Tazamun to slow down. It will retry shortly.

statusUpdateRequired.message: Another browser uses a newer version of Tazamun. Update this one to see everything.
statusUpdateRequired.description: Status line when records from a newer client are held (ENG-10) or the server needs a newer client.

statusPending.description: Number of outbox entries. Counts changes, not tabs or pages.

syncPause.description: Button: pause all sync on this browser (ENG-12).

tabsHeading.description: Popup heading of the other devices' tabs (TAB-6).

tabsNone.message: No tabs from other browsers yet. Connect another browser to see its tabs here.
tabsNone.description: Shown when no other device has published tabs.

tabsUnknownDevice.description: Device label when the device list couldn't be loaded.

tabsDeviceSeen.description: Device heading: name and when it was last seen.

tabsWindow.description: Window heading in the other tabs list.

tabsOpenAll.description: Button: open all tabs of that window in a new window.

tabsCopied.message: This browser can't open that address, so it was copied to the clipboard.
tabsCopied.description: Shown when opening a tab failed and the URL was copied (TAB-8).

tabsOpenFailed.message: This browser can't open that address.
tabsOpenFailed.description: Shown when opening failed and copying failed too.

onboardingReplaceNote.message: This browser profile is connected to an account on $SERVER$. Creating an account, or connecting to a different one, replaces it here: that account's synced data on this browser is removed (it stays on the server). To use both accounts, install Tazamun in a separate browser profile.
onboardingReplaceNote.description: Welcome page note when this browser profile already has an account (ACC-12).

menuSendPage.description: Context menu parent item on a page (UI-4).

menuSendLink.description: Context menu parent item on a link (UI-4).

menuNoDevices.description: Disabled context menu item when there is no other device.

sentTabTitle.description: Notification title when a tab was sent to this browser (TAB-7).

sentTabRefusedTitle.description: Notification title when the browser refused to open a sent tab (TAB-8).

sentTabRefused.message: This browser can't open $URL$. Copy the address from here if you need it.
sentTabRefused.description: Notification text when a sent tab was refused (TAB-8).

sendTo.description: Button: send the current tab to that device.

sendSent.message: Sent. It opens there within a minute or two.
sendSent.description: Shown after sending a tab (PERF-2: within 90 s).

sendPrivate.message: Tabs from private windows aren't sent.
sendPrivate.description: Shown when the current tab is in a private window.

sendNotWebPage.message: Only web pages can be sent.
sendNotWebPage.description: Shown when the current tab is a browser or local page.

sendNoDevices.message: Connect another browser to send tabs to it.
sendNoDevices.description: Shown when there's no other device.

sendFailed.message: The tab couldn't be sent. Try again.

moduleOffQuestion.message: Turn off tabs sync on this browser. Also delete this browser's tabs from the server, so your other browsers no longer show them?
moduleOffQuestion.description: Asked when turning off the tabs module (PRIV-2).

moduleOffDelete.description: Button: turn the module off and delete this device's data from the server.

moduleOffKeep.description: Button: turn the module off and keep the data on the server.

exclusionsHelp.message: One site per line. Tabs from these sites never leave this browser, and later its history won't either. bank.example also covers its subdomains; health.example/records covers only that part of the site.

exclusionsInvalid.message: These lines aren't usable site names: $LINES$

exclusionsAddExamples.message: Add common sign-in and mail sites

devicesHeading.description: Options section heading: the account's browsers.

devicesThisOne.description: Marks the current device in the list.

devicesRevokeConfirm.message: Remove “$DEVICE$” from your account? It stops syncing at once and has to sign in again with the passphrase.

devicesUnavailable.message: The device list can't be loaded right now.
devicesUnavailable.description: Shown when offline with no cached list.

usernameLabel.description: Label of the username field (sign-up, sign-in, recovery, options), and the username line of the recovery key document.

usernameHelp.message: 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores. You sign in with it on your other browsers; the server’s operator can see it.
usernameHelp.description: Help below the username field when creating an account.

errorUsernameInvalid.message: A username has 3 to 32 characters: letters a–z, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, and starts and ends with a letter or digit.
errorUsernameInvalid.description: Error: the username has the wrong form.

errorUsernameTaken.message: That username is already taken on this server. Choose another one.
errorUsernameTaken.description: Error: another account on the server has this username.

recoveryHeading.description: Heading of the onboarding step that shows the new recovery key.

recoveryLead.message: If you ever forget your passphrase, this key lets you set a new one. Save it now: it is shown only once. Keep it as safe as your passphrase, because together with your username it opens your account.
recoveryLead.description: Text above the new recovery key.

recoverySaved.message: I have saved my recovery key.
recoverySaved.description: Checkbox the user ticks before leaving the recovery key step.

errorRecoverySaved.message: Save the recovery key first (download, print or copy it), then tick the box.
errorRecoverySaved.description: Error: the user tried to continue without confirming the recovery key is saved.

recoveryKeyLabel.description: Label of the recovery key field, and the key line of the recovery key document.

recoveryDownload.description: Button: download the recovery key as a text file.

recoveryCopy.description: Button: copy the recovery key to the clipboard.

recoveryCopied.description: Shown after the recovery key was copied.

recoveryDocHeading.description: Heading of the downloaded or printed recovery key document.

recoveryDocServer.description: Server line of the recovery key document.

recoveryDocCreated.description: Date line of the recovery key document.

recoveryDocKeepSafe.message: Keep this key as safe as your passphrase: with your username it opens your account. Anyone who finds it can read your synced data.
recoveryDocKeepSafe.description: Warning in the recovery key document.

recoveryDocHowTo.message: Forgot your passphrase? Install Tazamun, choose “Sign in to an existing account”, enter the server and your username, then “Forgot your passphrase?”, and enter this key to set a new passphrase.
recoveryDocHowTo.description: How to use the recovery key, in the document.

forgotPassphrase.description: Link on the sign-in step that switches to recovery with the recovery key.

recoverLead.message: Enter your recovery key and choose a new passphrase. Your other browsers are signed out and sign in again with the new passphrase. The recovery key keeps working.

recoverButton.description: Submit button on the recovery step.

newPassphraseLabel.description: Label of the new passphrase field on the recovery step.

backToSignIn.description: Link on the recovery step back to normal sign-in.

errorRecoveryKeyFormat.message: A recovery key has 32 letters and digits, in 8 groups of 4.
errorRecoveryKeyFormat.description: Error: the typed recovery key has the wrong form.

errorRecoveryInvalid.message: The username or recovery key is wrong.
errorRecoveryInvalid.description: Error: the server refused the recovery key.

optionsUsername.description: Options: label of the username row.

optionsUsernameMissing.message: This account has no username yet. Choose one: without it, you can’t sign in on another browser.
optionsUsernameMissing.description: Options: shown for accounts created before usernames existed.

optionsUsernameSave.description: Options: button to set or change the username.

optionsUsernameHelp.message: Your other browsers stay signed in. Use the new username the next time you sign in.
optionsUsernameHelp.description: Options: help below the username field.

optionsRecoveryHeading.description: Options: heading of the recovery key section.

optionsRecoverySet.message: A recovery key is set. If you lost it, make a new one: the old one stops working.
optionsRecoverySet.description: Options: the account has a recovery key.

optionsRecoveryMissing.message: This account has no recovery key. Without one, a forgotten passphrase means lost data. Make one now.
optionsRecoveryMissing.description: Options: the account has no recovery key.

optionsRecoveryNew.description: Options: button that creates a new recovery key.

optionsRecoveryPassphrase.message: Enter your passphrase to make a new recovery key.
optionsRecoveryPassphrase.description: Options: prompt above the passphrase field when making a new recovery key.

optionsRecoveryLocked.description: Options: a new recovery key needs the account key, which a locked browser doesn’t have.

optionsRecoveryShown.message: Save this key now. It is shown only once, and the previous one no longer works.
optionsRecoveryShown.description: Options: shown with a newly made recovery key.
